body:
A Potent Microdose Experiment!
Last night I had a successful microdose experience off of 3 grams of fly agaric. I should also mention I took 50mgs of DPH (Benadryl) and some cannabis beforehand to counteract the stomach upset.
I started to feel effects just 10 to 20 minutes after consuming my amanita tea. This included a sudden onset of energy, soon followed by feeling weighted to the ground. I felt over heated, and as if my body was changing in size. I made myself comfortable, turned some music on, and tried to meditate and stay still as possible during this time. During the come up, I did experience some nausea and stomach upset, but it not last for more than an hour or so. To deal with said discomfort, I tried to mentally project myself into the music I was playing, which was more or less successful. Even at such a low dose, there was a distinct loss of self. It was easy to experience music as something that directly interacted with my being. I'd say I peaked around the 1.5 to 2.5 hour period.

For the first two hours, it was stronger than expected, which was not a bad thing. Even at higher doses of other dissociatives, I find myself able to project my thinking on to the trip, and remain focused. Not so here. There was very little distinction between myself, and my environment. Whereas on other dissociatives, I can completely disengage from my environment and go within. This will certainly be element I have to experiment with at higher doses of fly agaric!
About three hours into the trip, I started to become more grounded in myself and surroundings again. But I was still experiencing a distinct change in perception related to thinking and feelings. The best way I can described it is as an added softness of "fluff" between myself and my surroundings. It was certainly a positive sensation. Music continued to be a highly euphoric experience, and I was still able to "flow" with it, to a minor extent. I'd say I felt effects for a total of seven hours, but they continued to wane after the three hour mark.
I'll certainly be doing this again at a higher dose, probably within the 8 to 10 grams range. I will be looking to lessen the initial stomach upset though, as it was aggregating during an otherwise pleasant experience.
